description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Warden of the Eye, adding {C}{C}.
When Warden of the Eye dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Warden of the Eye on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Warden of the Eye from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating five tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Warden of the Eye and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers five times and Warden of the Eye triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
